General condition of the transformer kiosk or room:
Cleanliness of the kiosk or room
Condition of the kiosk sheet metal or the room walls
Height of the kiosk/room floor level above ground level
Earthing connections in the kiosk or room
Load balance across the three phases
Medium- and low-voltage fuses (sound and suitable)
End boxes for medium and low voltage
Numbers and designations of all cables
Burying all medium- and low-voltage cables
Maintenance card for the kiosk or room
Single-line diagram for medium and low voltage
Danger-of-death warning sign on the outside of the kiosk/room
